messages:
sam: Morning team — BlueWave POC demo next week. Need a hosted API key for their CI/test runners. Requirements: expire after 21 days, automatic rotation every 7 days, scope=generate only (no embeddings/admin), IP allowlist for their runners, and audit logging enabled. Can someone provision and add to onboarding docs?
rachel: I can take this. Quick question: do they want console-managed rotated keys or short-lived STS tokens? For CI persistence console-managed rotated key (auto-rotate) is simpler.
sam: Console-managed rotated please. We need final revocation after day 21. Tag it with sales:bluewave. IPs: 52.9.0.0/20 and 54.12.34.56/32. Rate limit target: 30 req/s steady, burst 100. Also they mentioned referer header checking — does hosted support that?
rachel: We only support IP allowlist and scope restrictions on hosted keys today. I'll note referrer limitation to the customer. Creating key with label 'bluewave-sandbox-poc', rotation=7d, expiry=21d, and audit logs true. ETA ~10m.
infra-bot: Creating key...
Key created: key_id=rwk_a9b2e1, expires=1946680000, scopes=[generate], ip_allowlist=[52.9.0.0/20,54.12.34.56/32], rate_limit=30r/s, burst=100, tags=[bluewave-poc,sales:bluewave], rotation=7d, audit_logging=true, owner=rachel
rachel: Done. Pushed onboarding snippet to the shared docs and DM'd the customer with the key id. Rotation snippet added to docs:
```bash
# rotate via admin API
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/admin/keys/rotate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"key_id":"rwk_a9b2e1"}'
```
sam: Nice. Can we schedule a pre-demo revocation (safety policy) the day after expiry to ensure we don't leave keys open? BlueWave asked for automatic cleanup after POC.
rachel: I'll create a calendar reminder for day 22 to revoke and produce a short post-POC access summary. Also added owner note and ACL in the key metadata.
sales-engineer: One quick question: will this key ever fall back to Dedicated pools if hosted is busy? Demo latency is sensitive.
rachel: It's pinned to the hosted us-east pool for this key. Small POC traffic shouldn't trigger fallback. If they hit issues we can request capacity pin or spin dedicated capacity.
sam: Great. Thanks everyone. I'll send the official onboarding email to infra@bluewave.com and include the docs link. Ping me if they need IP changes or different scope.
